tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: ONE full-body single pose of the exact Sakhalin Taimen adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the simplified nonhumanoid animal prop; no human hands/arms/legs/eyebrows/lips or new large eyes. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 BLINK: Exact ordinary resting reference stance, proportions and anatomical support with ONLY eyelids gently fully closed as simple curves. Keep skull top, torso length and thickness, belly, resting forelimbs, legs and support unchanged. Do not squat, shrink the torso, inflate the head, lower the skull, lift the resting arms or feet. On the 1254 square full canvas reproduce the image1 placement as closely as possible. Species constraints: 人の腕・脚を追加しない。ヒゲ・斑・横帯・背鰭・尾の二叉形や非対称形を各原画どおり保つ。地面・水面・泡を追加しない。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states.
